===== ASSISTANT SOURCE =====
from core.agent.context import ConversationContext
from core.agent.executor import CommandExecutor
from core.agent.intent import IntentDetector, IntentType
from core.agent.planner import AgentPlanner
from core.agent.semantic import SemanticToolEngine

from core.memory.intent import MemoryIntentType
from core.memory.service import MemoryService

from core.agent.agent import RiyaAgent
from core.ai.local_runtime import LocalLlamaRuntime


class RIYAAssistant:
    """
    Main RIYA application interface.

    Public interface:

        assistant = RIYAAssistant()
        assistant.process("...")
        assistant.close()

    Architecture:

        User
          ↓
        Memory
          ↓
        Deterministic Router
          ↓
        Semantic Tool Retrieval
          ↓
        AI Planner
          ↓
        Security
          ↓
        Tool Execution
          ↓
        Verification
          ↓
        RIYA Response
    """

    def __init__(self):

        # =====================================================
        # RIYA AGENT
        # =====================================================

        self.agent = RiyaAgent()

        # =====================================================
        # LOCAL SEMANTIC ENGINE
        # =====================================================

        self.semantic = SemanticToolEngine(
            self.agent.tools,
            top_k=8,
        )

        # =====================================================
        # LOCAL AI
        # =====================================================

        self.ai = LocalLlamaRuntime(
            context_size=4096,
            max_tokens=256,
        )

        # =====================================================
        # MODEL
        # =====================================================

        self.model_path = self._find_model()

        self.ai.load_model(
            str(self.model_path)
        )

        # =====================================================
        # CORE COMPONENTS
        # =====================================================

        self.intent_detector = IntentDetector()

        self.command_executor = CommandExecutor(
            self.agent
        )

        self.memory = MemoryService()

        # =====================================================
        # AI PLANNER + SEMANTIC ENGINE
        # =====================================================

        self.planner = AgentPlanner(
            self.ai,
            self.agent.tools,
            semantic_engine=self.semantic,
        )

        # =====================================================
        # CONVERSATION CONTEXT
        # =====================================================

        self.context = ConversationContext(
            max_messages=12
        )

        # =====================================================
        # PENDING CONFIRMATION
        # =====================================================

        self.pending_action = None

    # =========================================================
    # MODEL LOCATION
    # =========================================================

    def _find_model(self):

        from pathlib import Path

        candidates = [

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Project model
            # -------------------------------------------------

            Path.home()
            / "Projects"
            / "RIYA"
            / "models"
            / "Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf",

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Hugging Face cache
            # -------------------------------------------------

            Path.home()
            / ".cache"
            / "huggingface"
            / "hub"
            / "models--lmstudio-community--Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF"
            / "snapshots",
        ]

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Direct model file
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        for candidate in candidates:

            if candidate.is_file():

                return candidate

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Search Hugging Face snapshots
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        hf_snapshots = candidates[-1]

        if hf_snapshots.exists():

            for snapshot in hf_snapshots.iterdir():

                if not snapshot.is_dir():
                    continue

                model_file = (
                    snapshot
                    / "Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf"
                )

                if model_file.exists():

                    return model_file

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "RIYA local Qwen3 model was not found.\n"
            "Expected either:\n"
            f"  {candidates[0]}\n"
            "or the existing Hugging Face cache."
        )

    # =========================================================
    # MAIN PROCESSING
    # =========================================================

    def process(
        self,
        user_input: str,
    ) -> str:

        user_input = user_input.strip()

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Empty input
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if not user_input:

            return (
                "Please tell me what you'd like me to do."
            )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Pending confirmation
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if self.pending_action is not None:

            return self._handle_confirmation(
                user_input
            )

        # =====================================================
        # MEMORY SYSTEM
        # =====================================================

        memory_intent = self.memory.detect(
            user_input
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Recall
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            memory_intent.type
            == MemoryIntentType.RECALL
        ):

            response = self.memory.execute_safe(
                memory_intent
            )

            response = response or (
                "I couldn't find that memory."
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # List memories
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            memory_intent.type
            == MemoryIntentType.LIST
        ):

            response = self.memory.execute_safe(
                memory_intent
            )

            response = response or (
                "RIYA has no stored memories."
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Remember
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            memory_intent.type
            == MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER
        ):

            action = (
                self.memory.build_remember_action(
                    memory_intent
                )
            )

            self.pending_action = {
                "tool": action["tool"],
                "parameters": action["parameters"],
            }

            category = (
                action["parameters"]["category"]
            )

            key = (
                action["parameters"]["key"]
            )

            value = (
                action["parameters"]["value"]
            )

            response = (
                f"I'll remember '{value}' "
                f"under '{category}' as '{key}'. "
                f"Proceed?"
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Forget
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            memory_intent.type
            == MemoryIntentType.FORGET
        ):

            action = (
                self.memory.build_forget_action(
                    memory_intent
                )
            )

            self.pending_action = {
                "tool": action["tool"],
                "parameters": action["parameters"],
            }

            category = (
                action["parameters"]["category"]
            )

            key = (
                action["parameters"]["key"]
            )

            response = (
                f"I'll forget the memory "
                f"'{key}' under '{category}'. "
                f"Proceed?"
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        # =====================================================
        # DETERMINISTIC COMMAND ROUTER
        # =====================================================

        intent = self.intent_detector.detect(
            user_input
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Exit
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if intent.type == IntentType.EXIT:

            return "Goodbye."

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Simple deterministic command
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if intent.type != IntentType.CHAT:

            try:

                result = (
                    self.command_executor.execute(
                        intent
                    )
                )

                response = self._format_result(
                    result
                )

                self._update_context(
                    user_input,
                    response,
                )

                return response

            except Exception as exc:

                response = (
                    "I couldn't complete that action: "
                    f"{exc}"
                )

                self._update_context(
                    user_input,
                    response,
                )

                return response

        # =====================================================
        # SEMANTIC + AI PLANNER
        # =====================================================

        try:

            plan = self.planner.create_plan(
                user_input
            )

        except Exception:

            plan = None

        # =====================================================
        # NORMAL CONVERSATION
        # =====================================================

        if plan is None or not plan.steps:

            response = self.ai.generate(
                user_input,
                conversation_context=(
                    self.context.format_for_prompt()
                ),
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        # =====================================================
        # MULTI-STEP EXECUTION
        # =====================================================

        results = []

        for step in plan.steps:

            try:

                result = self.agent.execute(
                    step.action,
                    **step.parameters,
                )

            except Exception as exc:

                response = (
                    "I couldn't complete the full task. "
                    f"The operation "
                    f"'{step.action}' failed: {exc}"
                )

                self._update_context(
                    user_input,
                    response,
                )

                return response

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Confirmation required
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if (
                isinstance(result, dict)
                and result.get("status")
                == "confirmation_required"
            ):

                self.pending_action = {
                    "tool": result.get(
                        "tool",
                        step.action,
                    ),
                    "parameters": result.get(
                        "parameters",
                        step.parameters,
                    ),
                }

                response = (
                    f"{result.get('reason', 'This action requires confirmation.')} "
                    "Proceed?"
                )

                self._update_context(
                    user_input,
                    response,
                )

                return response

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Execution failure
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if (
                isinstance(result, dict)
                and result.get("status")
                in {
                    "failed",
                    "verification_failed",
                }
            ):

                reason = result.get(
                    "reason",
                    result.get(
                        "error",
                        "Unknown failure.",
                    ),
                )

                response = (
                    f"I couldn't complete "
                    f"'{step.description or step.action}'. "
                    f"{reason}"
                )

                self._update_context(
                    user_input,
                    response,
                )

                return response

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Successful result
            # -------------------------------------------------

            results.append(
                {
                    "action": step.action,
                    "description": step.description,
                    "result": result,
                }
            )

        # =====================================================
        # FINAL RESULT
        # =====================================================

        response = self._summarize_results(
            results
        )

        self._update_context(
            user_input,
            response,
        )

        return response

    # =========================================================
    # CONFIRMATION
    # =========================================================

    def _handle_confirmation(
        self,
        user_input: str,
    ) -> str:

        normalized = (
            user_input.lower()
            .strip()
            .rstrip(".!?")
        )

        yes_words = {
            "yes",
            "y",
            "yeah",
            "yep",
            "sure",
            "ok",
            "okay",
            "confirm",
            "do it",
            "proceed",
            "go ahead",
            "please proceed",
            "continue",
        }

        no_words = {
            "no",
            "n",
            "nope",
            "cancel",
            "stop",
            "don't",
            "dont",
        }

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Cancel
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if normalized in no_words:

            self.pending_action = None

            response = (
                "Okay, I cancelled that action."
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Invalid confirmation
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if normalized not in yes_words:

            return (
                "Please say yes to proceed "
                "or no to cancel."
            )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Execute confirmed action
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        action = self.pending_action

        self.pending_action = None

        try:

            result = self.agent.execute(
                action["tool"],
                confirm=True,
                **action["parameters"],
            )

            response = self._format_result(
                result
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

        except Exception as exc:

            response = (
                "I couldn't complete the "
                f"confirmed action: {exc}"
            )

            self._update_context(
                user_input,
                response,
            )

            return response

    # =========================================================
    # RESULT FORMATTING
    # =========================================================

    def _format_result(
        self,
        result,
    ) -> str:

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Plain string
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if isinstance(result, str):

            return result.strip()

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Structured result
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if isinstance(result, dict):

            status = result.get(
                "status"
            )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Confirmation
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if status == "confirmation_required":

                self.pending_action = {
                    "tool": result.get(
                        "tool"
                    ),
                    "parameters": result.get(
                        "parameters",
                        {},
                    ),
                }

                return (
                    f"{result.get('reason', 'Confirmation required.')} "
                    "Proceed?"
                )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Failed
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if status == "failed":

                return (
                    "I couldn't complete the action. "
                    f"{result.get('error', 'Unknown error.')}"
                )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Verification failed
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if status == "verification_failed":

                return (
                    "The action was attempted, "
                    "but I could not verify that it "
                    "completed successfully. "
                    f"{result.get('reason', '')}"
                ).strip()

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Successful
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if status == "success":

                actual_result = result.get(
                    "result"
                )

                if isinstance(
                    actual_result,
                    str,
                ):

                    return actual_result.strip()

                if actual_result is not None:

                    return str(
                        actual_result
                    )

                verification = result.get(
                    "verification"
                )

                if isinstance(
                    verification,
                    dict,
                ):

                    reason = verification.get(
                        "reason"
                    )

                    if reason:

                        return str(
                            reason
                        )

                return (
                    "The action completed successfully."
                )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Unknown dictionary
            # -------------------------------------------------

            return str(result)

        return str(result)

    # =========================================================
    # MULTI-STEP SUMMARY
    # =========================================================

    def _summarize_results(
        self,
        results,
    ) -> str:

        if not results:

            return (
                "The task completed."
            )

        successful = []

        for item in results:

            raw_result = item.get(
                "result"
            )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Structured ToolExecutor result
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if isinstance(
                raw_result,
                dict,
            ):

                status = raw_result.get(
                    "status"
                )

                if status == "success":

                    actual_result = (
                        raw_result.get(
                            "result"
                        )
                    )

                    if actual_result is not None:

                        text = str(
                            actual_result
                        ).strip()

                        if text:

                            successful.append(
                                text
                            )

                        continue

                    verification = (
                        raw_result.get(
                            "verification"
                        )
                    )

                    if isinstance(
                        verification,
                        dict,
                    ):

                        reason = (
                            verification.get(
                                "reason"
                            )
                        )

                        if reason:

                            successful.append(
                                str(
                                    reason
                                ).strip()
                            )

                continue

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Plain string result
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if isinstance(
                raw_result,
                str,
            ):

                cleaned = (
                    raw_result.strip()
                )

                if cleaned:

                    successful.append(
                        cleaned
                    )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # No readable result
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if not successful:

            return (
                "Done. The requested actions "
                "were completed and verified."
            )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # One result
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if len(successful) == 1:

            return successful[0]

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Multiple results
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        lines = [
            "Done. I completed the requested actions:"
        ]

        for result in successful:

            lines.append(
                f"• {result}"
            )

        return "\n".join(
            lines
        )

    # =========================================================
    # CONVERSATION CONTEXT
    # =========================================================

    def _update_context(
        self,
        user_input: str,
        response: str,
    ) -> None:

        self.context.add_user(
            user_input
        )

        if response:

            self.context.add_assistant(
                response
            )

    # =========================================================
    # SHUTDOWN
    # =========================================================

    def close(self):

        if self.ai is not None:

            try:

                self.ai.unload_model()

            except Exception:

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum


class MemoryIntentType(str, Enum):

    NONE = "none"
    REMEMBER = "remember"
    RECALL = "recall"
    FORGET = "forget"
    LIST = "list"


@dataclass
class MemoryIntent:

    type: MemoryIntentType
    category: str | None = None
    key: str | None = None
    value: str | None = None


class MemoryIntentDetector:

    REMEMBER_PREFIXES = (
        "remember that ",
        "remember ",
        "save that ",
        "save ",
        "store that ",
        "store ",
        "keep in mind that ",
        "keep in mind ",
        "don't forget that ",
        "dont forget that ",
    )

    RECALL_PREFIXES = (
        "what do you remember about ",
        "what do you remember ",
        "do you remember ",
        "recall ",
        "tell me what you remember about ",
    )

    FORGET_PREFIXES = (
        "forget that ",
        "forget ",
        "remove the memory of ",
        "delete the memory of ",
    )

    LIST_PHRASES = {
        "list my memories",
        "show my memories",
        "show me my memories",
        "what do you remember about me",
        "what do you remember about me?",
        "what do you know about me",
        "what do you know about me?",
    }

    def detect(
        self,
        text: str,
    ) -> MemoryIntent:

        text = text.strip()

        if not text:
            return MemoryIntent(
                MemoryIntentType.NONE
            )

        normalized = text.lower()

        # PERSONAL MEMORY RECALL
        personal_question = normalized.rstrip(" ?.!")

        personal_recall_questions = {
            "what is my name",
            "what's my name",
            "what is my full name",
            "who am i",
            "tell me my name",
            "do you know my name",
        }

        if personal_question in personal_recall_questions:
            return MemoryIntent(
                type=MemoryIntentType.RECALL,
                category="personal",
                key="my_name",
            )

        # LIST
        if normalized in self.LIST_PHRASES:

            return MemoryIntent(
                MemoryIntentType.LIST
            )

        # REMEMBER
        for prefix in self.REMEMBER_PREFIXES:

            if normalized.startswith(prefix):

                content = text[
                    len(prefix):
                ].strip()

                if content:

                    return (
                        self._build_remember_intent(
                            content
                        )
                    )

        # FORGET
        for prefix in self.FORGET_PREFIXES:

            if normalized.startswith(prefix):

                content = text[
                    len(prefix):
                ].strip()

                if content:

                    return MemoryIntent(
                        type=(
                            MemoryIntentType.FORGET
                        ),
                        category="general",
                        key=self._make_key(
                            content
                        ),
                    )

        # RECALL
        for prefix in self.RECALL_PREFIXES:

            if normalized.startswith(prefix):

                content = text[
                    len(prefix):
                ].strip()

                if content:

                    return MemoryIntent(
                        type=(
                            MemoryIntentType.RECALL
                        ),
                        category="general",
                        key=self._make_key(
                            content
                        ),
                    )

        return MemoryIntent(
            MemoryIntentType.NONE
        )

    def _build_remember_intent(
        self,
        content: str,
    ) -> MemoryIntent:

        category = "general"

        key = self._make_key(
            content
        )

        value = content

        lowered = content.lower()

        # ------------------------------------------
        # "X is Y"
        # ------------------------------------------

        markers = (
            " is ",
            " are ",
            " = ",
        )

        for marker in markers:

            index = lowered.find(marker)

            if index > 0:

                left = content[
                    :index
                ].strip()

                right = content[
                    index + len(marker):
                ].strip()

                if left and right:

                    key = self._make_key(
                        left
                    )

                    value = right

                    category = (
                        self._infer_category(
                            left
                        )
                    )

                    return MemoryIntent(
                        type=(
                            MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER
                        ),
                        category=category,
                        key=key,
                        value=value,
                    )

        # ------------------------------------------
        # "I prefer X"
        # ------------------------------------------

        if lowered.startswith(
            "i prefer "
        ):

            value = content[
                len("I prefer "):
            ].strip()

            return MemoryIntent(
                type=(
                    MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER
                ),
                category="preferences",
                key="preferred",
                value=value,
            )

        # ------------------------------------------
        # "I like X"
        # ------------------------------------------

        if lowered.startswith(
            "i like "
        ):

            value = content[
                len("I like "):
            ].strip()

            return MemoryIntent(
                type=(
                    MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER
                ),
                category="preferences",
                key="likes",
                value=value,
            )

        # ------------------------------------------
        # "I don't like X"
        # ------------------------------------------

        if lowered.startswith(
            "i don't like "
        ):

            value = content[
                len("I don't like "):
            ].strip()

            return MemoryIntent(
                type=(
                    MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER
                ),
                category="preferences",
                key="dislikes",
                value=value,
            )

        # ------------------------------------------
        # "My favorite X is Y"
        # ------------------------------------------

        if lowered.startswith(
            "my favorite "
        ):

            marker = " is "

            index = lowered.find(
                marker
            )

            if index > 0:

                left = content[
                    len("My favorite "):
                    index
                ].strip()

                right = content[
                    index + len(marker):
                ].strip()

                if left and right:

                    return MemoryIntent(
                        type=(
                            MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER
                        ),
                        category="preferences",
                        key=(
                            "favorite_"
                            + self._make_key(
                                left
                            )
                        ),
                        value=right,
                    )

        return MemoryIntent(
            type=MemoryIntentType.REMEMBER,
            category=category,
            key=key,
            value=value,
        )

    def _infer_category(
        self,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:

        lowered = text.lower()

        if any(
            word in lowered
            for word in (
                "favorite",
                "favourite",
                "prefer",
                "preference",
                "like",
                "dislike",
            )
        ):
            return "preferences"

        if any(
            word in lowered
            for word in (
                "project",
                "application",
                "app",
                "software",
            )
        ):
            return "projects"

        if any(
            word in lowered
            for word in (
                "job",
                "work",
                "company",
                "office",
            )
        ):
            return "work"

        if any(
            word in lowered
            for word in (
                "name",
                "birthday",
                "location",
                "city",
            )
        ):
            return "personal"

        return "general"

    def _make_key(
        self,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:

        words = []

        for word in text.lower().split():

            cleaned = "".join(
                character
                for character in word
                if character.isalnum()
            )

            if cleaned:
                words.append(
                    cleaned
                )

        if not words:
            return "memory"

        return "_".join(
            words[:8]

===== core/tools/memory.py =====
from core.memory.manager import MemoryManager


_memory = MemoryManager()


def remember(
    category: str,
    key: str,
    value: str,
) -> str:

    return _memory.remember(
        category=category,
        key=key,
        value=value,
    )


def recall_memory(
    category: str,
    key: str,
) -> str:

    value = _memory.recall(
        category=category,
        key=key,
    )

    if value is None:
        return (
            f"I don't have a memory for "
            f"'{key}' in '{category}'."
        )

    return value


def list_memories(
    category: str | None = None,
) -> str:

    memories = _memory.list_memories(
        category=category
    )

    if not memories:
        return (
            "RIYA has no stored memories."
        )

    lines = []

    for memory in memories:

        lines.append(
            f"{memory['category']}: "
            f"{memory['key']} = "
            f"{memory['value']}"
        )

    return "\n".join(lines)


def forget_memory(
    category: str,
    key: str,
) -> str:

    deleted = _memory.forget(
        category=category,
        key=key,
    )

    if not deleted:
        return (
            f"I don't have a memory for "
            f"'{key}' in '{category}'."
        )

    return (
        f"Forgot '{key}' from "
        f"'{category}'."

===== tests/test_confirmation_flow.py =====
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock

from core.agent.assistant import RIYAAssistant


class TestConfirmationFlow(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        # Bypass __init__: do not load AI models or databases.
        self.assistant = RIYAAssistant.__new__(RIYAAssistant)
        self.assistant.pending_action = {
            "tool": "remember",
            "parameters": {
                "category": "personal",
                "key": "my_name",
                "value": "Tukaram",
            },
        }
        self.assistant.agent = Mock()
        self.assistant.agent.execute.return_value = {
            "status": "success"
        }
        self.assistant._format_result = Mock(
            return_value="Memory saved."
        )
        self.assistant._update_context = Mock()

    def test_yes_executes_action(self):
        result = self.assistant._handle_confirmation("yes")

        self.assertEqual(result, "Memory saved.")
        self.assistant.agent.execute.assert_called_once_with(
            "remember",
            confirm=True,
            category="personal",
            key="my_name",
            value="Tukaram",
        )
        self.assertIsNone(self.assistant.pending_action)

    def test_no_cancels_action(self):
        result = self.assistant._handle_confirmation("no")

        self.assertIn("cancelled", result.lower())
        self.assistant.agent.execute.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIsNone(self.assistant.pending_action)

    def test_unclear_response_keeps_pending_action(self):
        result = self.assistant._handle_confirmation("maybe")

        self.assertIn("yes", result.lower())
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.assistant.pending_action)
        self.assistant.agent.execute.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
===== tests/test_memory_database.py =====
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from core.memory.database import MemoryDatabase
from core.memory.manager import MemoryManager


class TestMemoryDatabase(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.database = MemoryDatabase(
            Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "test.db"
        )
        self.memory = MemoryManager(self.database)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def test_save_and_recall(self):
        self.memory.remember("personal", "my_name", "Tukaram")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.memory.recall("personal", "my_name"),
            "Tukaram"
        )

    def test_update_existing_memory(self):
        self.memory.remember("personal", "my_name", "Alex")
        self.memory.remember("personal", "my_name", "Tukaram")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.memory.recall("personal", "my_name"),
            "Tukaram"
        )

    def test_missing_memory_returns_none(self):
        self.assertIsNone(
            self.memory.recall("personal", "unknown")
        )

    def test_memory_persists_after_reopening_database(self):
        self.memory.remember("personal", "my_name", "Tukaram")

        reopened_database = MemoryDatabase(
            self.database.database_path
        )
        reopened_memory = MemoryManager(reopened_database)

        self.assertEqual(
            reopened_memory.recall("personal", "my_name"),
            "Tukaram"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
